annotations.summary: More than one abnormal WebSocket close (close-code class `error`) per second across the hosts and kernels gateways.
LLM API error rate exceeds 5% over at least 20 calls in 10 min; below that volume a handful of failures is not a rate.
HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 5% over 5 minutes.
Redis memory is above 70% of its limit for 10 minutes. The instance runs without eviction, so at 100% it refuses writes: pairing, GitHub connect, git leases and rate limits fail.

rules.title: GenAiPromptCacheHitRateLow: Prompt cache hit rate below 40% (cost bleed)

model.expr:
(
  (
    sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api", gen_ai_token_type="cache_read"}[30m]))
    or
    0 * sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[30m]))
  )
  /
  sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api", gen_ai_token_type=~"input|cache_read|cache_write"}[30m]))
) < 0.4
and
sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[30m])) >= 200000

annotations.summary: Prompt cache hit rate <40% sustained for 30m on a model with non-trivial volume.
annotations.description: Provider-side prompt caches (Gemini implicit, Anthropic incremental, OpenAI prompt) are not hitting on {{ $labels.gen_ai_provider_name }}/{{ $labels.gen_ai_request_model }} despite >=200K input tokens billed in the last 30m. This is a cost-bleed signal, not a user-facing failure. Common causes: per-turn-mutating prefix bytes (token-usage reminders, dynamic system-prompt fields), tool-list churn, or provider request-shape regressions. See docs/research/gemini-prompt-cache-busting.md for the diagnosis playbook.

rules.title: P1: Funded LLM Pool Near Failsafe

annotations.summary: A funded LLM capacity pool has remained above 87.5% of its 64-operation abuse failsafe.
A primary funded LLM request reached the account abuse failsafe after recovery.
Funded LLM recovery failed; admission remains fail-closed without changing customer money.

rules.title: P1: Funded LLM Recovery SLO Breach

annotations.summary: The oldest due funded LLM operation has exceeded the 30-second healthy recovery SLO.
DB-only funded LLM recovery observed a provider execution; the invariant is zero.

A Tau process (app or billing worker) restarted more than twice in 30 min: it is crash-looping (F-10: billing-operations OOM-kills on a 256 MB Machine, before its first pass completes). Reads process_uptime, which exists from the first scrape. A deploy restarts it once.

rules.title: P1: Supplier Cost Above 85% of Charge

model.expr: sum by (app, gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}[24h])) / (sum by (app, gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_provider_name) (increase(gen_ai_client_cost_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}[24h])) * 1e12) > 0.85

annotations.summary: Over 24 h, a model's metered supplier cost is above 85% of what customers were charged for it (expected about 0.77 at the 30% markup), and has stayed there for 24 h: the route's pinned supplier rate or retail price is wrong. Supplier cost is an estimate written on the terminal receipt (charter W3), live-settled operations only; recovery-settled ones are in the unpriced gauge. Grouped by Fly `app`, model and provider. Soft alert: the provider console limit is the cap (BIL-21).

model.expr: (sum by (deployment_environment) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}[24h])) / 1e12 > on (deployment_environment) clamp_min(3 * sum by (deployment_environment) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}[7d] offset 24h)) / 7 / 1e12, 50)) or (sum by (deployment_environment) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}[24h])) / 1e12 > 50 unless on (deployment_environment) sum by (deployment_environment) (increase(tau_billing_supplier_cost_picousd_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}[7d] offset 24h)))

annotations.summary: Metered supplier spend in the last 24 h for one environment is above max(US$50, 3x its trailing 7-day daily mean); with no 7-day history, above US$50. A runaway agent, a mispriced route or abuse. Soft alert: the provider console hard limit is the cap (BIL-21). increase() cannot see a counter's first sample, so a new process under-counts by one call.

model.expr: (max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason=~"missing_rate|dimension_mismatch"}) > on (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) (max_over_time(tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason=~"missing_rate|dimension_mismatch"}[1h] offset 2h))) or (max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason=~"missing_rate|dimension_mismatch"}) > 0 unless on (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku, tau_billing_unpriced_reason) (max_over_time(tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason=~"missing_rate|dimension_mismatch"}[1h] offset 2h)))

annotations.summary: New settled operations carry no supplier-cost estimate because a route's supplier valuation is incomplete (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations with reason `missing_rate` or `dimension_mismatch` grew, or a provider/SKU/reason appeared, in the last 2 h): it needs a code fix. Cut streams (`absorbed`) have their own rate rule, billing-supplier-absorbed-usage. The gauge is a running total recorded hourly by billing-operations, so this rule watches its growth, not its level; the baseline is the gauge's maximum over the hour ending 2 h ago, so a scrape gap is not read as a new series. Clears 2 h after the last increase.

model.expr: (max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason="absorbed"}) - on (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) (max_over_time(tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason="absorbed"}[1h] offset 1h)) > 10) or (max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason="absorbed"}) > 10 unless on (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) max by (app, deployment_environment, gen_ai_provider_name, tau_billing_sku) (max_over_time(tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_billing_unpriced_reason="absorbed"}[1h] offset 1h)))

annotations.summary: More than 10 settled operations in one provider/SKU were absorbed unpriced in the last hour (tau_billing_supplier_unpriced_operations with reason `absorbed` grew by more than 10, or appeared above 10): cut streams or expired recoveries at an unusual rate, so a client, the gateway or a provider is aborting turns. A single client abort is expected and does not fire. The gauge is a running total recorded hourly by billing-operations; the baseline is its maximum over the hour ending 1 h ago, so a scrape gap is not read as a new series.

rules.title: P1: Supplier Invoice Does Not Match Meter

annotations.summary: reconcile-supplier-invoice found a provider invoice total outside tolerance of the summed supplier cost on terminal receipts and opened a supplier_invoice_total_mismatch case. Operator work; it blocks nothing. The case evidence carries both totals and the unpriced and unattributed counts.

rules.title: P1: Customer Owed for More Than 2 h

annotations.summary: Tier T2: Tau has owed a named customer for more than 2 h: the oldest open missing_local_payment, paid_unfulfilled_recovery or unfulfilled_purchase_obligation case (paid, not yet credited or fulfilled) is older than 2 h. Nothing is refused; the customer is waiting for what they paid for. Start with the billing lifecycle `list-cases` with `attributed: true`, then follow paid-not-credited. Pages as billing-owed-overdue-24h after 24 h. Reads the oldest-case age gauge, written hourly. Grouped by Fly `app` and case kind.

rules.title: P1: Bookkeeping Case Open for More Than 24 h

annotations.summary: Tier T3, daily digest (repeat_interval 24h): one of Tau's bookkeeping cases (gross_fee_net_mismatch, refund_unresolved, dispute_balance_transaction, tax_registration_review or a supplier_* kind), attributed or not, has been open for more than 24 h. No customer is refused anything. Run the billing lifecycle `list-cases` and work each row by its owner, next step and deadline. An unattributed row also pages as billing-case-unattributed; billing-supplier-invoice-mismatch still warns on its own. Grouped by Fly `app` and case kind.

model.expr: sum by (tau_runtime_operation) (rate(tau_runtime_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_runtime_cause="implementation"}[15m])) / sum by (tau_runtime_operation) (rate(tau_runtime_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_runtime_outcome!~"superseded|cancelled|abandoned"}[15m])) > 0.05 and sum by (tau_runtime_operation) (increase(tau_runtime_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_runtime_cause="implementation"}[15m])) >= 10 and sum by (tau_runtime_operation) (increase(tau_runtime_operations_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_runtime_outcome!~"superseded|cancelled|abandoned"}[15m])) >= 50

annotations.summary: More than 5 % of one operation's completed runtime attempts failed with an implementation-class cause (failed, discarded, or an implementation-class issue) over 15 min, with at least 10 failures and 50 completed attempts. Completed excludes superseded, cancelled and abandoned, so merged counts cannot move the ratio. Drill: T14 fixture, which stops at its own deadline.

At least 5 runtime attempts in 15 min ended in a host limit kill, an unexplained host exit, a timeout recovery or a client deadline (error.type on the errors counter; a timed-out attempt carries RUNTIME_OPERATION_TIMEOUT). Drill: a desktop runner with a low residentLimit.
More than 10 % of runtime worker boots (initialize) failed over 15 min, with at least 5 failures and 20 boots. Drill: T04 fixture.

Capacity refusals (RESOURCE_LIMIT issues and supervisor limit kills) over the last hour are more than twice their 7-day hourly mean, with at least 20 in the hour. Info until a 7-day baseline exists, then warning. Added paused (package.md §12.2): info rules stay paused until Tau Cloud PR-5a gives them per-rule repeat and routing, so they never mail the operator contact every four hours.

Stall evidence: worker replies that arrived after their attempt settled plus abandoned attempts longer than 120 s reached 5 in an hour. Cancellation, supersession and abandonment never page. Drill: T23 in CI only. Added paused (package.md §12.2): info rules stay paused until Tau Cloud PR-5a gives them per-rule repeat and routing, so they never mail the operator contact every four hours.

model.expr: sum by (tau_runtime_backend) (increase(tau_runtime_viewer_events_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_runtime_viewer_event="context-lost"}[1h])) / sum by (tau_runtime_backend) (increase(tau_runtime_viewer_events_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_runtime_viewer_event="first-frame"}[1h])) > 0.02 and sum by (tau_runtime_backend) (increase(tau_runtime_viewer_events_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",tau_runtime_viewer_event="first-frame"}[1h])) >= 200

annotations.summary: More than 2 % of viewer first frames on one backend (webgl, webgpu) were followed by a context loss in the last hour, with at least 200 first frames (FR-17). Drill: Playwright forced WEBGL_lose_context in T12. Added paused (package.md §12.2): info rules stay paused until Tau Cloud PR-5a gives them per-rule repeat and routing, so they never mail the operator contact every four hours.
At least 5 jobs of one provider entered attention_required in the last hour (FR-15). Read from the job attention counter, once per job, never from the operations denominator. Drill: T20 fixture.
The runtime telemetry ingest rejected or overflowed at least 100 entries in 15 min (invalid, rate-limited, unknown entry or Loki event overflow). Drill: T10, with a hard deadline.

Hosts reported at least 10,000 spans refused by worker collectors at their 10,000-entry bound in an hour (D-T5): local traces are being lost under load. Drill: T22 in CI. Added paused (package.md §12.2): info rules stay paused until Tau Cloud PR-5a gives them per-rule repeat and routing, so they never mail the operator contact every four hours.

model.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_count{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",http_route!="/v1/telemetry/ingest",http_route=~"/v1/(projects|chat|privacy).*"}[30m])) > 0.05) and on() (max(tau_telemetry_runtime_enabled{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}) == 1) and on() (absent_over_time(tau_telemetry_ingest_entries_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",disposition="recorded"}[30m]) or on() (sum(increase(tau_telemetry_ingest_entries_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",disposition="recorded"}[30m])) == 0))

annotations.summary: Other UI traffic reaches the API but no runtime telemetry entry was recorded for 30 min, on a deployment whose runtime telemetry is on (the clause on tau_telemetry_runtime_enabled keeps a self-hosted or paused API silent; the billing gate plays no part). Route labels are illustrative until W4 reads the real http_route values. Drill: T15, a self-expiring pause.

The p95 age of the oldest entry in delivered runtime telemetry batches exceeded 120 s over 30 min, with at least 20 batches. Drill: throttled network in Playwright. Added paused (package.md §12.2): info rules stay paused until Tau Cloud PR-5a gives them per-rule repeat and routing, so they never mail the operator contact every four hours.

An API instrument reached its cardinality limit and is recording into its otel_metric_overflow="true" series, so it undercounts. Every registry metric is covered, not only tau_runtime_*: today's instruments keep the SDK default of 2,000 series (FR-29, D-T16). Drill: T10 label-stress script.

The runtime telemetry ingest admitted batches while Redis was unavailable for the rate budget or the dedupe key for 10 min (fail-open, counted; FR-23). Drill: Redis fault injection in CI only (T29); on staging the rule is observational.

Signed-out runtime telemetry surged: recorded signed-out entries over the last hour exceed three times their 7-day hourly mean with at least 2,000 in the hour, or at least 1,000 signed-out entries were rate-limited in 15 min (AR-W4-07). Drill: T10 many-network flood, with a hard deadline.

Always firing: the operator's weekly receipt proves the notification path, and a missing receipt is the alarm (resolved Q19). Requires Tau Cloud PR-5a for a 7-day repeat interval; until then it stays paused and the operator's scheduled contact-point test replaces it.

Some rule in this environment's folder entered an Error state in the last 30 min, by Grafana's own alert state history (Loki, logical datasource alert-state-history; folderUID="tau-local" binds to tau-<environment>). Lines carry ruleTitle, ruleUID and error: query {from="state-history", folderUID="tau-<environment>"} | json | current=~"Error.*" to see which rule failed and why. Excludes its own title so its own evaluation error cannot keep it firing. Locally the datasource maps to the local Loki, which has no state-history streams; the local copy stays paused.

model.expr: sum by (app, tau_worker) (max_over_time(tau_agent_evidence_passes_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api"}[24h])) unless sum by (app, tau_worker) (increase(tau_agent_evidence_passes_total{app=~".*",service_name="tau-api",outcome="ok"}[15m]) > 0)

annotations.summary: An agent-evidence worker seen in the last 24 h has completed no successful pass in 15 min. lifecycle stalled means sealed payloads past their 180-day retention are not purged and erasures are not sent to Langfuse; delivery stalled means admitted evidence is not delivered. Grouped by Fly `app` and `tau_worker`.

rules.title: P1: Agent Evidence Never Became Visible

annotations.summary: At least one acknowledged or uncertain Langfuse send was still invisible 15 min later and was recorded as a gap. It is never resent, because a late write would duplicate it, so Langfuse is missing evidence Tau holds a receipt for.

rules.title: P1: Agent Evidence Held for a Missing Payload Key

annotations.summary: Backlog payloads are sealed under a key version this deployment no longer has (`TAU_OBSERVABILITY_PAYLOAD_KEY_VERSION` rotated without the old key). They are held, not sent, until the key returns or retention purges them.

rules.title: P1: Agent Evidence Refused at Capacity

annotations.summary: Evidence admission has been refusing submissions at the backlog byte budget (`TAU_OBSERVABILITY_BACKLOG_BYTES` or the per-principal budget) for 15 min. Hosts keep their queues and retry; delivery is not draining as fast as evidence arrives.

rules.title: P1: Agent Evidence Erasure Not Progressing

annotations.summary: For 2 h Langfuse trace deletions have been retried (a 429, a 5xx, a timeout or an unreachable host) with none accepted. An accepted delete is the erasure and Tau does not read it back; erasure of a deleted account is owed within a day, so check Langfuse availability and the deletion API's answer codes in the lifecycle log.
Langfuse rejected a send, or a backlog payload could not be opened or parsed. The evidence is dropped, never retried; the row's bounded reason says which.

rules.title: P1: Langfuse Units at 70% of Hobby Plan

annotations.summary: Tau wrote 35,000 Langfuse units in the last 31 days, 70% of the Hobby plan's 50k a month (a unit is a trace, an observation or a score; ruling 13). Bound to this environment's API, as every hosted rule is, while staging and production share the organisation's 50k: add the other environment's figure from the Langfuse units panel. Respond in order: pause staging delivery (TAU_OBSERVABILITY_DELIVERY_ENABLED), build sampling (LW13), or reopen the plan. The counter misses units Langfuse features or other projects create, and increase() cannot see a new process's first sample.

rules.title: P1: API Response Stream Severed (Fly PU05)

annotations.summary: Fly's proxy logged [PU05] (could not finish reading the response body from the instance) for an API Machine in the last 5 min: a response stream was cut mid-body, in practice a funded LLM step on /v1/llm/* killed by a stop that did not drain (2026-11-05 deploy cut). Fly's proxy line carries no request path, so every API response counts. Check the Machine's stop lines and api-exit-without-drain, then whether a funded step was cut and settled.

model.expr: sum by (fly_app_instance) (count_over_time({service_name="tau-api"} | event_provider="app" |= "Main child exited" |= `"process_group":"app"` [2m])) unless on (fly_app_instance) sum by (fly_app_instance) (count_over_time({service_name="tau-api"} | event_provider="app" |= "Shutdown drained" [5m]))

annotations.summary: An API app Machine's init logged `Main child exited` with no `Shutdown drained` on the same Machine in the 5 min before: the process died without completing its graceful drain (a repeated stop signal, a crash or a SIGKILL at kill_timeout). In-flight model steps were cut without the zero settlement; read the Machine's log around the exit and the funded-operation recovery rules.

rules.title: P1: Pooler Login at 80% of Its Session Pool

annotations.summary: API pooled PostgreSQL clients are at 12 of the 15-client session pool for 2 minutes (database connection audit R4). The sum is every API instance's own request and background sockets plus the 2 of revisions-maintenance, which shares the login and exports no metrics. The prod-us login's Supavisor session pool is 15 and the declared budget is 2 × (4 + 1) + 2 = 12 (apps/api/app/config/connection-budget.test.ts); a third Machine or a raised pool cap is the usual cause.
